question: What fruit follows non-renouncers after death?
premises: threefold fruit of action becomes for non-renouncers after death
ignorant men impose agency-burden on self
inference: non-renunciation binds through self-imposed agency, not thing-state
uncertainties: fused tokens may contain sandhi and punctuation
plain_english: Threefold fruit of action comes to non-renouncers after death, never to renouncers; ignorant men, though causes stand, impose the whole burden of agency on the self and bind themselves by their own intellect, not by thing-state.
